methods.name: General GMM: linear IV (two-step, iterative, CUE, one-step fixed W; iid / MDS / HAC) and normal-distribution moments
methods.reference: gmm::gmm 1.9.1 (type, vcov, wmatrix, weightsMatrix, centeredVcov, kernel, bw, prewhite), gmm::specTest
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md at n = 500 (coefficients 1e-8, SE/J/p 1e-6); iterated, CUE and Gauss-Newton fits use Tol::iterative with the same values, documented per test

deviations.quantity: J for a fixed weighting matrix (ident_mds_J, fixedw_mds_J)
deviations.note: gmm prints n g' Omega^-1 g for wmatrix = 'ident' and weightsMatrix; it is not chi-squared(q - k) for a non-optimal W, so p2a reports NaN; recorded, not pinned

deviations.quantity: default HAC weight (vcov = HAC without kernel or bandwidth)
deviations.note: p2a's default is the Bartlett kernel with floor(4 (n/100)^(2/9)) lags and no prewhitening, = gmm(kernel = 'Bartlett', bw = m + 1, prewhite = 0), pinned as twostep_hac_bartlett; gmm's default (Quadratic Spectral, bwAndrews, prewhite = 1) is not implemented: twostep_hac, twostep_hac_bw, cue_hac, cue_hac_bw are recorded, not pinned

methods.name: Marginal treatment effects by local IV (probit/logit first stage, polynomial in P): ATE, ATT, ATU, LATE(p_min,p_max), PRTE; delta-method and bootstrap SEs
methods.reference: no R package (ivmte computes LP bounds; localIV not installed): glm probit polished to the MLE by Newton + lm cubic + Heckman & Vytlacil (2005) weights written out in R (validation/r/cases/econ_mte.R); delta-method SEs with sandwich::vcovHC(type = 'HC1')
quantities: bootstrap SD, percentile CI and mean
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md: n = 2000 estimates 1e-10, SEs and shares 1e-8; n = 719 and n = 400 estimates 1e-8, SEs and CIs 1e-6 (relative); first-stage coefficients Tol::iterative(1e-10) against the probit MLE (R: glm, then Newton); the second-stage polynomial coefficients and MTE(u) Tol::iterative(1e-8), because the cubic amplifies the first stage's convergence error
